answer: A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in vine, and atlas reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 104 aliases, and each one needs its own funded wharf account. A farm of 3177 identities would post 2243 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
